title: U.S. Coast Guard members board semi-submersible during counternarcotics patrol
description: Members of the Coast Guard Cutter Waesche (WMSL-751) law enforcement boarding team inspect a self-propelled semi-submersible (SPSS) in Eastern Pacific Ocean international waters November 2023. The biggest of the six drug interdictions during the counternarcotics patrol occurred Nov. 20, consisting of a self-propelled semi-submersible (SPSS) carrying more than 5,500 pounds of cocaine. (U.S. Coast Guard Video)
